# proxmox_sdn_dns (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox VE SDN DNS provider through `/cluster/sdn/dns`. Only the `powerdns` type exists. DNS providers stage like the other SDN objects and only take effect when `proxmox_sdn_apply` commits; a zone references them by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# DNS providers stay staged until proxmox_sdn_apply commits the SDN
# configuration. Zones reference them through `dns`.
# Provider credentials need SDN.Allocate on /sdn/dns.
resource "proxmox_sdn_dns" "powerdns" {
  dns         = "pdns1"
  type        = "powerdns"
  url         = "https://powerdns.example.com/api"
  key         = var.powerdns_api_key
  ttl         = 300
  fingerprint = var.powerdns_fingerprint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dns` (String) DNS provider identifier: starts with a letter, only letters and digits, at least 2 characters. Changes require replacement.
- `key` (String) PowerDNS API key. Proxmox stores it in `/etc/pve/sdn/dns.cfg`, not in a private file.
- `type` (String) DNS provider type; only `powerdns`. Changes require replacement.
- `url` (String) PowerDNS API URL.

### Optional

- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the PowerDNS TLS certificate.
- `reversemaskv6` (Number) Netmask used for the IPv6 reverse zone name.
- `ttl` (Number) Default DNS record TTL.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) DNS provider identifier (same as `dns`).
- `pending` (Map of String) Properties Proxmox currently reports as staged but not committed, with `deleted` for removals.
- `state` (String) Proxmox staging state: `new` or `changed` while the DNS provider is not committed yet.
